metadata.title: Create Backend Test Plan
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Create comprehensive ADO test plans for backend work items. Loads config, fetches work item, runs sniffing checklists, generates test cases, maps against existing coverage, and pushes to Azure DevOps. Use as a standalone test planning process or as a sub-process within the SDLC orchestrator.

steps.name: Load & Validate Config
steps.output: Resolved qa-config.json with team settings, plan ID, suite IDs, base branch

guidance.autoDiscovery: If config missing or has null values, auto-discover from work item area path
guidance.rule: Do NOT proceed until config is fully resolved and confirmed by user

steps.name: Pull Work Item Details
steps.output: Work item details: title, description, AC, detailed solution, relations, area/iteration path

guidance.fallback: If search_code fails, clone repo locally and read files directly

steps.name: Execute Sniffing
steps.output: Sniffing findings: scope/impact, risks, cross-service concerns, code changes, requirements vs code mapping

guidance.codeAnalysis: Run git diff against base_branch from config. Group files by type. Identify endpoints affected.
guidance.hierarchy: Traverse up one level to parent work item. Go further only if parent lacks AC.
guidance.crossReference: Compare AC vs code. Flag: requirements not in code, code not in requirements, unstated behaviors.
guidance.budget: Stop exploring when you can articulate what the feature does, what flows are affected, and what could go wrong.

guidance.skipIf: AC are clear and specific, code changes align with requirements, no critical ambiguities
guidance.mustAsk: Ambiguous AC with multiple valid interpretations that change test case content
guidance.assumeAndNote: Test data specifics, environment details, non-functional requirements

guidance.rule: Open HTML in browser. Do NOT proceed until user explicitly approves context.

steps.name: Generate Test Cases & Map Coverage
steps.output: test-plan-review-{id}.json + combined HTML viewer with test cases and coverage mapping

guidance.calibration: 2-4 TCs for config change, 5-8 for new endpoint, 8-12 for multi-endpoint, 10-15 for cross-service
guidance.mapping: Classify each TC as New, Update, Skip, or Obsolete against existing coverage
guidance.rule: Open combined HTML viewer. Do NOT proceed until user explicitly approves test cases and mapping.

steps.name: Push Test Plan to ADO
steps.output: Test cases created/updated in ADO, linked to work item

actions: Create new test cases via wit_create_work_item
Add test cases to target suite
Link test cases to work item

steps.name: Report Results
steps.output: Final report with ADO links, regenerated HTML

actions: Backfill ADO IDs into review JSON
Regenerate HTML with clickable ADO links
Display summary of all actions taken
